component.name: Parley
component.summary: Practice languages locally with voice and text

description.p: Parley is a local language tutor that combines a language model, speech recognition and speech synthesis. It supports Portuguese, English, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean and Mandarin Chinese, and keeps conversations, audio and vocabulary on your machine.

ul.li: Voice and text conversation with 19 role-play scenarios
Spoken stories with a downloadable audio pack
No accounts, cloud APIs or telemetry

description.p: PC 1.0.0 release: improved model/setup flow, Whisper model guidance, Speak Replies default on, level test with 15 questions, and packaging updates for Linux and Windows installers.

Cleaner pronunciation phrases, conversation prompts that do not repeat earlier questions, bundled or declared Noto Sans CJK fonts, translated CJK home buttons, and Android support for llama.cpp and offline use through Termux.
Conversation scoring with per-language progress and a guided level test, system-following themes, model download confirmation, voice removal and CJK font detection.
First GTK 4 release with Italian, spoken stories and on-demand audio.
